ash (docs): Hey all — quick thread to finalize a compact "Rate & Quota" migration block. PR: https://rwd/pulls/5901. Needs: 1) short Py/TS/Go quota-check snippet, 2) header matrix for hosted vs private, 3) tiny blurb on burst credits and a screenshot fallback for dashboard links.

devin (sdk): I'll push code fixes. Important: meter v2 deprecates X-Rate-Limit-Remaining. Document both X-Quota-Org (hosted) and X-Tenant-Quota (private) and recommend /quota as primary.

mira (product): For burst credits keep it illustrative: multi-tenant → per-org burst; dedicated → shared pool. Add a 1-line example table (sample numbers only).

raj (analytics): Add a troubleshooting callout: "tokens != requests" — background jobs/embeddings can eat tokens without incrementing request count. Show both fields in snippets.

ash (docs): Draft Python snippet (very small) in PR:
```python
from redwood import Client
c=Client()
q=c.quota.get()
print(q.tokens_left, q.requests_left)
if q.requests_left>0:
  r=c.generate(model="rw-medium",prompt="hi")
  print(r.id, r.quota_left)
```

devin (sdk): Tiny edits: use snake_case (already there), add basic error handling in examples and avoid leaking keys. I'll push a micro-commit.

ash (docs): For dashboard, ci-bot flagged internal grafana link — I'll attach a sanitized screenshot and add caption: "internal panel (illustrative) — use permalinks for private embeds".

ci-bot: Link-check: https://grafana.internal/tenant-consumption returned 403. Recommend screenshot artifact for docs.

mira (product): +1 on messaging. Also suggest a short migration checklist at top: audit headers, update SDKs, validate dashboards.

devin (sdk): Pushed small fixes for JS and Go snippets (showing tokens_left & requests_left).

raj (analytics): Adding the troubleshooting note and the sample table to the PR now.

ash (docs): Please review the PR and react with :white_check_mark: when green. I'll merge after CI and the screenshot are attached.
